m: माचाकीय m. N. of a grammarian, TPrāt.
माची—पत्त्र n. a species of medicinal plant, L. (cf. मञ्चि-प्˚).

s: puM, (mA aYcatIti । anca + kaH .) panTAH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: माच m. a way, road, L. (cf. माठ, माथ).

s: puM, (mA calati BogamadatvAcireREva sTAnaM na muYcatIti । cala + ac .) grahaH । rogaH । (mA calati svacCandaM na prasaratIti । cal + ac .) । vandI । cOraH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ medinyAM grahasTAne grAha iti pAWaH ॥
m: माचल m. (perhaps fr. 1. मा + चल) a thief, robber, L.
a: माचलः — 1 A thief, robber. --2 A crocodile.

s: strI, (mA aYcati kzatAdikaM tyaktvA na gacCatIti । anc + kaH । tataH kan । wAp । ata itvam .) makzikA । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ ambazWA । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥

m: माचिका f. a fly, L. (cf. गृह-म्˚) Hibiscus Cannabinus, Bhpr. (cf. काक-म्˚).

s: vya (mA ciram .) SIGram । yaTA, -- “aTAbravIttadA matsyastAnfzIn prahasan SanEH । asmin himavataH SfNge nAvaM baDnIta mAricam ॥” iti vanaparvvaRi mAtsyopAKyAnam ॥

m: मा—चिरम् ind., ‘not long’, shortly, quickly, MBh.; R.; Pur. (generally after an Impv. or augmentless aor., and almost always at the end of a verse; sometimes mc. for न-चिरम्, q.v.)
माचिरम् See under 1. मा, p. 804, col. 2.
